name: gibraltarmusicfestival.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.gibraltarmusicfestival.com scores 69 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 15 elements on /, for example button[type="submit"] and .outside-travel > details[open=""]:nth-child(1) > p. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Next.js 16.2.9 has known flaws
fix.evidence: Next.js 16.2.9 (read from the page): 17 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-64647, CVE-2026-64646, CVE-2026-64648. Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used. Checked against the…

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /, for example .carousel__dots. Impact: critical.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example #react-aria9393457432-_r_8_ and #react-aria9393457432-_r_a_. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /terms, /privacy, for example .legal-page-module__2SHKvq__brand. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 3 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).
